note: Curriculum version 5: reading tips for the new resources, and the new day for each existing resource.

c5-nng-persona.howToUse: Read it for the purpose of personas; you will make a quick people map, not posters.

c5-okta-baw.howToUse: Skim the headline findings; note who decides and who sets things up.

c5-nng-heuristics.howToUse: Read all ten once; keep the list open while you do the teardown.

c5-nng-heuristic-eval.howToUse: Use the method, but keep it small: one task, three findings.

c5-mdn-internet.howToUse: Start here. Read it through once and look at every picture.

c5-mdn-ip.howToUse: Read it, then find your own laptop’s address.

c5-mdn-dns.howToUse: Read it before you try a DNS lookup yourself.

c5-mdn-tls.howToUse: Read the first sections; skip the cipher details.

c5-ts-how.howToUse: Read it through; redraw the hub-and-spoke versus mesh pictures yourself.

c5-ts-nat.howToUse: Read the opening sections and look at the diagrams; skim the rest.

c5-ts-what.howToUse: Read it before you install anything.

c5-ts-tailnet.howToUse: Read it, then look for each idea in your admin console.

c5-ts-magicdns.howToUse: Turn it on while you read.

c5-ts-sharing.howToUse: Read it, then share one device and remove the share.

c5-ts-cli.howToUse: Optional. Skim the command list to see how technical users work.

c5-cf-warp.howToUse: Read the overview and note the first-run steps.

c5-zerotier-start.howToUse: List the steps and the words it uses.

c5-nng-onboarding.howToUse: Read it before you redesign the onboarding.

c5-ms-iam.howToUse: Read it once for the big picture; do not try to remember every product name.

c5-docker-desktop.howToUse: Download and install it today so Day 3 starts with the exercise, not an install.

c5-ms-authn.howToUse: Read it and note each method you have used yourself.

c5-cisa-mfa.howToUse: Notice the words it uses; they are a model for product copy.

c5-nng-passwords.howToUse: Read it as a designer: where do security rules make people’s lives harder?

c5-owasp-tm.howToUse: Skim it after the Manifesto; it repeats the same ideas in other words.

c5-ms-phishing.howToUse: Read it, then think of the last suspicious email you received.

c5-ts-zt.howToUse: Read it first today; it is the plainest version.

c5-ts-grants.howToUse: Read the first examples carefully; skim the advanced capabilities.

c5-ts-policy-syntax.howToUse: Use it as a reference: look up groups, tagOwners and tests when you need them.

c5-twingate-how.howToUse: Read it and draw its model next to Tailscale’s.

c5-nng-interviews.howToUse: Read it before your first conversation.

c5-nng-problem.howToUse: Use its structure for your case study 1 problem statement.

c5-okta-scim.howToUse: Read the overview and the provisioning diagram.

c5-entra-provisioning.howToUse: Read it as the admin you will design for in Exercise 10.

c5-keycloak-oidc.howToUse: Read the overview and the endpoints section; skip the adapter details.

c5-nng-wizards.howToUse: Read it before you redesign the SSO setup flow.

c5-k8s-overview.howToUse: Read the overview and the “why you need Kubernetes” section.

c5-k8s-labels.howToUse: Read it with network policies in mind.

c5-k8s-service.howToUse: Read the introduction and the first example.

c5-k8s-netpol.howToUse: Read up to and including the default policies section.

c5-calico-about.howToUse: Read it to understand Tigera’s main product.

c5-kind.howToUse: Follow the install and create-cluster steps only.

c5-calico-kind.howToUse: Follow it exactly; copy each command carefully.

c5-calico-k8s-policy.howToUse: Work through the examples in your cluster.

c5-calico-default-deny.howToUse: Read it before you break your app on purpose.

c5-calico-policy.howToUse: Optional: skim to see what Calico adds, such as ordering and global policies.

c5-calico-recommend.howToUse: Read it closely and screenshot any diagrams; this is your competitor and inspiration.

c5-calico-staged.howToUse: Read it closely; staged enforcement is part of case study 2.

c5-cilium-hubble.howToUse: Look at the screenshots and the service map idea.

c5-cilium-policy.howToUse: Optional: skim the overview for your teardown.

c5-nng-journey.howToUse: Use it for the journey in your problem statement.

c5-ts-flowlogs.howToUse: Read what a flow log contains and what it does not.

c5-ts-auditlog.howToUse: Compare it with flow logs: changes versus traffic.

c5-calico-flowlogs.howToUse: Read it, then use it in Exercise 13.

c5-pd-alert-fatigue.howToUse: Read it and note the causes; they are design problems.

c5-mitre.howToUse: Look at the matrix and open two techniques; do not try to read it all.

c5-pd-response.howToUse: Read the “before”, “during” and “after” overviews and the roles.

c5-cisa-ttx.howToUse: Skim one package to see how a tabletop is structured.

c5-nng-data-tables.howToUse: Read it before you design the triage view.

c5-nng-dashboards.howToUse: Use it for the summary part of your triage view.

c5-nng-notifications.howToUse: Read it and decide what deserves an interruption.

c5-ts-roles.howToUse: Read it and list what each role can and cannot do.

c5-entra-reviews.howToUse: Read the overview and when to use reviews.

c5-entra-pim.howToUse: Read what it does and the reasons to use it.

c5-ts-jit.howToUse: Read it and compare with Microsoft PIM.

c5-aicpa-soc.howToUse: Skim what SOC 2 covers; you do not need the details.

c5-vanta-soc2.howToUse: Read the first sections: what it is, who asks for it, Type 1 versus Type 2.

c5-opa.howToUse: Read the introduction and look at one example policy.

c5-ts-gitops-github.howToUse: Follow it for your test tailnet.

c5-nng-progressive.howToUse: Read it before you sketch concepts.

c5-nng-complex-apps.howToUse: Use it as a checklist for your concepts.

c5-nng-usability-testing.howToUse: Read it before you test with two people.

c5-owasp-nhi.howToUse: Read the list and the short description of each.

c5-k8s-serviceaccounts.howToUse: Read the introduction and the use cases.

c5-gh-secret-scanning.howToUse: Read it as a design example of warning people about leaked secrets.

c5-gcp-wif.howToUse: Optional: read the overview to see the “no keys” pattern in a real cloud.

c5-owasp-llm01.howToUse: Read the description and the example scenarios.

c5-nng-confirmation.howToUse: Read it before the security UX review.

c5-nng-errors.howToUse: Use it to judge error and warning messages.

c5-ts-careers.howToUse: Open any design or product role and list its skills.

c5-tigera-careers.howToUse: Open any design or product role and list its skills.

c5-nng-portfolio.howToUse: Read it before polishing your case studies.

c5-nng-critiques.howToUse: Read it before your practice retrospective.
